name: Loot Frenzy
hook: Spam claim every skin in the shop before the server hotfix hits
tagline: A sweaty battle royale kid feverishly clicks 'Claim All' as rare skins, banana suits, and neon pickaxes pile to the ceiling. Cash out to glider-dive away with a backpack stuffed with free cosmetic glory. Crash and Epic pushes an emergency patch that confiscates your inventory down to default sweatpants.
